title: Stative Verbs
subtitle: состояние, восприятие и мнение -> обычно Simple

ruleBlocks.text: Некоторые глаголы выражают состояние, восприятие или мнение, а не действие. Такие глаголы называются stative (non-continuous) verbs.

ruleBlocks.title: Главное правило
lines: Stative-глаголы обычно не используются в Continuous-временах.
Для факта, мнения, отношения или состояния выбираем Simple-форму.
Если значение глагола меняется на действие/процесс, Continuous становится возможным.
Смысл важнее формы: один и тот же глагол может быть и stative, и dynamic.

items.en: I believe you're right, but I don't agree with your methods.
items.ru: believe и agree выражают мнение/состояние, поэтому здесь Present Simple.

items.en: She is looking at the stars.

ruleBlocks.caption: Частые группы
rows: know, remember, understand, believe, realise, mean
love, like, hate, dislike, prefer, regret
be, have (possession), belong, own, possess, include, contain, consist
статичный факт о человеке, предмете или системе

ruleBlocks.caption: Список, который стоит выучить (ядро)
rows: agree, appear, be, believe, consider, doubt, exist, forget, forgive, hate
know, love, matter, mean, mind, need, prefer, realise, remember, regret
have*, include, involve, own, possess, suit, weigh*
suppose, think*, understand, want, wish, wonder

ruleBlocks.text: Глаголы со звездочкой (*) могут использоваться и в Simple, и в Continuous. Все решает значение в конкретном предложении.

ruleBlocks.caption: Чувствуем разницу
rows: I see a cat on the roof.
She is looking at the stars.

ruleBlocks.title: Проверочная фраза
lines: «...поувидеть» звучит неестественно -> see чаще остается в Simple.
«...посмотреть / понаблюдать» естественно -> look/watch легко идут в Continuous.

ruleBlocks.caption: Пассивное vs активное восприятие
rows: I hear birds outside my window.
She is listening to her favorite playlist.

ruleBlocks.title: Вывод
lines: listen = активное действие -> Continuous возможен и часто нужен.
Смысл «действие или состояние?» всегда проверяем в контексте.

ruleBlocks.caption: Когда Continuous возможен, а когда нет
rows: She is smelling the candle to choose a scent.
The air smells like fresh rain.
He is tasting the sauce to check it.
The doctor is feeling my pulse. / I'm feeling much better today.
This fabric feels soft. / I feel he's right.
The vet is weighing the puppy.
She is looking through old photos.
He looks exhausted after the trip.
I'm seeing a dentist tomorrow. / She is seeing her colleague.
I see your point now. / Do you see those clouds?
The court is hearing a complicated case now.
We're having dinner with our neighbours tonight.
I have a new laptop for work.
I'm thinking about taking a gap year.
I think this plan will work.

ruleBlocks.title: Алгоритм за 5 секунд
lines: 2) Это действие-процесс в моменте? -> возможен Continuous.
3) Сравни значение: I think (мнение) vs I'm thinking (процесс).
4) Если сомневаешься, начни с Simple и проверь, не скрывается ли активное действие.

ruleBlocks.title: Связанные темы
ruleBlocks.note: После этого блока полезно закрепить контраст между Simple и Continuous.

items.prompt: I believe you're right, but I don't agree with this method.
items.explain: believe и agree здесь выражают мнение, поэтому выбираем Simple.

items.prompt: Look! The children are watching the horses.
items.explain: watch = активное наблюдение, контекст Look! -> процесс в момент речи.

items.prompt: I hear birds outside my window.
items.explain: hear = просто слышать, обычно не требует Continuous.

items.prompt: She is listening to her favorite playlist.
items.explain: listen = активное действие, поэтому Continuous естественен.

items.prompt: This soup tastes amazing.
items.explain: taste здесь означает характеристику блюда (стативное значение).

items.prompt: The chef is tasting the soup right now.
items.explain: is tasting = процесс: человек пробует еду прямо сейчас.

items.prompt: I think your idea is brilliant.
items.explain: think в значении «считаю» обычно используется в Simple.

items.prompt: I'm thinking about moving abroad.
items.explain: I'm thinking = «обдумываю сейчас», это процесс.

items.prompt: We have two dogs.
items.explain: have в значении possession обычно не употребляется в Continuous.

items.prompt: We're having dinner with our neighbours tonight.
items.explain: have dinner = действие, поэтому форма Continuous допустима.

items.prompt: The package weighs two kilos.
items.explain: weigh в значении веса предмета = stative.

items.prompt: The assistant is weighing the package now.
items.explain: is weighing = выполняется действие «взвешивает».

items.prompt: You look tired after the trip.
items.explain: look в значении «выглядеть» обычно берется в Simple.

items.prompt: She is looking for her keys.
items.explain: look for = действие поиска, поэтому Continuous уместен.

items.prompt: I'm seeing my dentist tomorrow morning.
items.explain: see в значении «встречаться/посещать» может использоваться в Continuous.

exercises.title: Формы глагола (Present Simple vs Present Continuous)

items.prompt: This coffee has a strong, bitter flavour; I ____ it a little sweeter. (prefer)
items.explain: prefer = отношение/мнение, поэтому Simple.

items.prompt: There are several reasons why people ____ everything they read or see on the internet. (believe)
items.explain: believe обычно статичен -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: Why ____ your time on TikTok instead of doing homework? (you still waste)
items.explain: Вопрос о действии в процессе сейчас -> Present Continuous.

items.prompt: I ____ to hurt your feelings. I ____ around. (not mean / just joke)
items.explain: mean (намереваться в этом контексте) и joke around как процесс.

items.prompt: My answer to this question ____ the same - I ____. (remain / not know)
items.explain: Оба глагола статичны в этом контексте -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: I ____ your point of view, but I still ____ with you. (see / disagree)
items.explain: see (понимать) и disagree (мнение) -> обычно Simple.

items.prompt: A weekend trip to the lake ____ me perfectly right now. I ____ a break from studying. (suit / need)
items.explain: suit и need здесь описывают состояние/потребность.

items.prompt: We'd better head home now, as it ____ late and I ____ extremely tired. (get / feel)
items.explain: get late = процесс изменения; feel может быть Simple или Continuous в значении текущего самочувствия.

items.prompt: I ____ with Mum's opinion on social media, but I ____ her right to express it. (not agree / respect)
items.explain: agree/respect = отношение, поэтому Simple.

items.prompt: I ____ my laptop to finish this project because my tablet ____ at the moment. (use / charge)
items.explain: Оба действия происходят сейчас -> Continuous.

items.prompt: When you ____ nothing is lacking, the whole world ____ to you. (realise / belong)
items.explain: Обобщенная мысль/истина -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: The aroma of the soup ____ absolutely mouthwatering, and it ____ my stomach rumble. (be / make)
items.explain: Описание состояния и факта реакции -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: I usually ____ breakfast at 7 a.m., but today I ____ a leisurely breakfast at 8 o'clock. (have / enjoy)
items.explain: usually -> Present Simple, today (сейчас/временная ситуация) -> Present Continuous.

items.prompt: Can you give me a minute? I ____ to my classmate how to solve this tricky math problem, but he still ____ anything. (explain / not understand)
items.explain: explain = текущий процесс, understand = stative (обычно Simple).

items.prompt: There ____ 95 million Instagram posts daily. This ____ photo uploads, stories, and reels shared on the platform. (be / include)
items.explain: Статистика и общий факт -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: A: I see you ____ a new laptop! How ____ you ____ it? B: It ____ a lot of useful features. I'm really enjoying it!
items.explain: have как possession -> has/have; like в вопросе с do.

items.prompt: A: You ____ a bit stressed. What's happened? B: I ____ for my wallet. I can't find it anywhere.
items.explain: look (выглядеть) -> Simple, look for (искать) -> Continuous.

items.prompt: A: I ____ this book will be a great read. Have you read the first chapter? B: Yes! I ____ of reading more this evening.
items.explain: think (мнение) vs am thinking (процесс обдумывания).

items.prompt: A: I need your advice. I ____ different candles to choose a new one. B: This one ____ fantastic! I like it the most.
items.explain: am smelling = действие, smells = характеристика запаха.

items.prompt: A: This cake ____ amazing! Who baked it? B: I ____ it for the first time. I think it's chocolate and raspberry.
items.explain: taste как характеристика -> Simple, как действие «пробовать» -> Continuous.

items.prompt: A: I ____ you are really into painting lately. Are you taking lessons? B: Yes, I ____ it.
items.explain: see (понимать/замечать) и love обычно берутся в Simple.

items.prompt: A: ____ you ____ any weekend plans? B: Actually, I do. I ____ a small barbecue with friends.
items.explain: Do you have = possession/наличие, am having = запланированное событие.

items.prompt: A: Did you hear about the new cafe downtown? ____ to check it out this weekend? B: Definitely! I ____ to go there because everyone ____ about it. It ____ really cozy! A: I read it ____ amazing desserts. B: Yeah, and the menu ____ delicious too.
items.explain: want/look/sound/have в статичных значениях и talking/planning как процессы.

items.prompt: A: ____ the latest documentary on space exploration now? B: Not really. It ____ very interesting to me. A: Really? It ____ that science show we saw last year. B: I ____ it. I ____ it's the same.
items.explain: watching = процесс, а seem/resemble/doubt/believe обычно stative.

items.prompt: A: ____ Anna is serious about joining the yoga class? B: I ____ it! She ____ that committed. B: I ____. It ____ her anyway. She ____ running.
items.explain: В этом диалоге почти все глаголы статичны: think, doubt, seem, agree, suit, prefer.

items.prompt: A: Hey, ____ when the outdoor movie night starts? B: I ____ it begins at 8 p.m. A: Great! I really ____ to watch my favorite film. A: Everyone ____ about it! It's going to be fun.
items.explain: know/want -> stative; is now talking -> текущий процесс в сообществе.

items.prompt: A: Did you hear that Leo changed schools? A: He says he's bored and ____ to try something different. B: But that's risky! ____ that it might be hard to adjust? B: I ____ he stays safe. A: Anyway, let's grab a snack. I ____.
items.explain: want/understand/hope -> состояния, am starving -> текущее ощущение как процесс/состояние момента.

items.prompt: They ____ a party at the pool right now.
items.explain: right now -> процесс в момент речи.

items.prompt: I ____ it is going to rain.
items.explain: think в значении мнения обычно берется в Simple.

items.prompt: ____ my new dress?
items.explain: like в значении отношения -> Simple вопрос с do.

items.prompt: Kim ____ dinner at the moment.
items.explain: at the moment -> процесс сейчас.

items.prompt: The girls ____ very helpful today.
items.explain: temporary behaviour today -> are being.

items.prompt: Lemons ____ sour.
items.explain: taste как характеристика продукта -> Simple.

items.prompt: What ____ at?
items.explain: look at как действие в момент речи -> Continuous question.

items.prompt: The children ____ in Father Christmas.
items.explain: believe = мнение/убеждение, обычно Simple.

items.prompt: Sam ____ a yellow T-shirt today.
items.explain: today указывает на ситуацию текущего дня -> is wearing.

items.prompt: We ____ visiting our grandparents.
items.explain: love обычно stative, поэтому без Continuous.

items.prompt: The car ____ to Mark.
items.explain: belong = состояние принадлежности -> Simple.

items.prompt: The boys ____ lunch right now.
items.explain: have lunch = действие в процессе, right now.

items.prompt: I ____ what the answer is.
items.explain: know почти всегда stative -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: The children ____ at the horses.
items.explain: look at = целенаправленное действие, поэтому Continuous.

items.prompt: ____ another cup of tea?
items.explain: В вежливом предложении используем шаблон Would you like...

items.prompt: It ____ like there is someone at the door.
items.explain: sound в значении впечатления/восприятия обычно в Simple.

items.prompt: Mum ____ pasta for dinner tonight.
items.explain: have dinner/meal tonight = запланированное действие.

items.prompt: The chef ____ the sauce to see if it needs more salt.
items.explain: to see if it needs more salt -> действие дегустации сейчас.

items.prompt: Nicky ____ very silly today.
items.explain: temporary behaviour today -> is being.

items.prompt: Daniel ____ brown hair and blue eyes.
items.explain: have в значении внешней характеристики/обладания -> has.

items.prompt: John ____ (think) about his future.
items.explain: Здесь think = процесс обдумывания.

items.prompt: Ali ____ (have) three sisters.
items.explain: have = possession -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: It ____ (smell) like something is burning.
items.explain: smell здесь = характеристика запаха, не действие.

items.prompt: The boys ____ (play) with their new toys.
items.explain: play как текущее действие -> Continuous.

items.prompt: Sara ____ (look) like she's been crying.
items.explain: look в значении внешнего вида -> Simple.

items.prompt: I ____ (want) another coffee.
items.explain: want обычно stative -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: We ____ (have) a really good time.
items.explain: have a good time = действие/событие, возможен Continuous.

items.prompt: Alice and Peter ____ (need) to go to the shop.
items.explain: need в значении необходимости -> Simple.

items.prompt: The shop ____ usually very busy. (be)
items.explain: usually + be -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: The baby ____ (sleep) on the sofa.
items.explain: Текущее действие -> Present Continuous.
